_about: Glossary terms of the Phase 1b home and code-map writer (src/index.html, src/code/plugins-init.html). Owner: c1 writer.

general-plugin.short: A function in the entry-point group vllm.general_plugins. vLLM calls it with no arguments, at most once in each process, usually to register something.
general-plugin.long: Loaded by load_general_plugins() ({{cite vllm/plugins/__init__.py:77-90}}). vLLM's own LoRA resolvers are general plugins ({{cite pyproject.toml:45-47}}).

endpoint-plugin.short: A plugin in the group vllm.endpoint_plugins that adds HTTP routes to the API server. It loads only when VLLM_PLUGINS names it.
endpoint-plugin.long: The entry point gives a factory that returns an object with name, required_tasks, attach_router() and init_state() ({{cite vllm/plugins/endpoint_plugins/interface.py:49-94}}).

io-processor-plugin.short: A plugin in the group vllm.io_processor_plugins. It changes the input and the output of a pooling model, for example an image in and an image out.
io-processor-plugin.long: The function behind the entry point returns the qualified name of an IOProcessor subclass, or None ({{cite vllm/plugins/io_processors/__init__.py:63-69}}). The image example is from the design docs ({{cite docs/design/io_processor_plugins.md:3}}).

lora-resolver.short: An object that finds a LoRA adapter by name when a request asks for an adapter that the server does not know yet, for example in a local folder.
lora-resolver.long: Resolvers register in LoRAResolverRegistry ({{cite vllm/lora/resolver.py:52-72}}). OpenAIServingModels in the API server gets them ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/models/serving.py:113-117}}) and asks them for an unknown adapter ({{cite vllm/entrypoints/openai/models/serving.py:325-326}}).
